name: background/aurora-drift
title: Aurora Drift
desc_vi: Ba vùng màu mờ, rất lớn, trôi chậm theo đường sin trên nền tối có vignette; lặp khít một vòng. Bản gốc rất nhẹ: muốn thấy rõ thì tăng amount.
params_vi: accent: green | blue | violet hoặc mã màu · mood: deep | bright · length: số giây cho một vòng (30) · amount: độ trôi so với bản gốc (1 = rất nhẹ như HF; demo dùng 3)
notes: The source drives x/y per frame (gsap.set in an onUpdate, sin of a phase that runs 0 -> 2 pi once over the whole length). Here the same path is literal tweens: every blob has an outer box that moves in x and an inner box that moves in y, each cut where the sine reverses (a half wave is exactly sine.inOut; the two partial waves at the cut ends use one fitted cubic Bezier, see ease_fit). Amplitudes, phase offsets (0, 120, 240 deg), sizes, positions, blur 12 % of the short side, saturate 0.84, screen blend, per-blob opacity, mood table and vignette are as in the source; accent colours are the source token fallbacks (#34d399, #38bdf8, #a78bfa). The loop length is param length (default 30 s) instead of the composition duration: make the scene at least that long, or pass a shorter length. The accent mixing (color-mix) is kept as CSS. Source variable accent is a name or a hex colour here. Gallery review 05/10: the source drift is barely visible (mean pixel change 2-3/255), so a param amount (amplitude x, default 1 = source) was added; the demo uses amount 3, length 6.

elements.text: Màu sắc dịu nhẹ, chuyển động chậm
